consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at the Berkeley Greek Theatre on July 15, 1988, was strong, with notable energy and solid musicianship throughout the show. The setlist featured several standout moments, particularly in the first set, and many reviewers praised the laid-back vibe of the performance, although some noted issues with tuning and forgotten lyrics.
